grants: TestDiscoveryParityTest: not a type but a wall of parity snapshots - one inline list per GENERATED registry (test classes, pins, arms, claims, deferred arms, dead fixtures), one assertion each. Its member count is a quarter of its own limit; the LINES are data that grows with the tree and with nothing else, so every slice that adds a fixture or an arm pushes it further. Splitting by registry would leave one half of the same contract in another file and still leave every list growing.
